programs.title: Africa Express
programs.desc:
For the first time, the race will take participants through Africa.They will cover the route through Kenya and Tanzania - from the foot of Kilimanjaro, through the crowded streets of Arusha, to the sand dunes by the Indian Ocean and historic Mombasa, ending the competition in Nairobi.Eight couples: Ewa Gawryluk-Domaniecka with her husband Piotr Domaniecki, Edyta Zając with her partner Michał Mikołajczak, Nikodem Rozbicki with her friend Paweł Kurkowski, Wiktoria Gąsiewska with her brother Mateusz Gąsiewski, Tomasz Iwan with her partner Karolina Woźniak, Katarzyna Niezgoda with her husband Paweł Markiewicz, Izu Ugonoh with his wife Antonina Ugonoh and MonikaHoffman-Piszora, together with her sister Iga Hoffman, faces the challenges of harsh, unpredictable nature - lack of roads, difficult access to water and communication, time pressure and their own emotions.The program will be hosted by Iza Krzan.Every day, participants must demonstrate perseverance, cooperation and resilience, learning about completely different faces of Africa.It's a test of boundaries and a lesson in friendship
In the eighth episode, the contestants go to the legendary Fort Jesus in Mombasa, where a test of trust and courage awaits them.After a welcome ceremony led by locals, half of the participants disappear, and their partners must follow clues hidden in the fort's nooks and crannies to try to find them.Exploring dark cells, a dry cistern and bastions overlooking the ocean, players complete a demanding mission.The end of this trial surprises everyone.Instead of their own partners, the participants find other people and from then on they race in completely new duos.

programs.title: Success knows no limits
programs.desc: The second season of the program about Poles who decided to put everything on one card and prove that the life of an emigrant can be full of success.This season, Tomasz Kin will once again meet extraordinary people who found their happiness abroad.The protagonist of the series will include Radosław Malinowski, a lawyer living in Nairobi, who helps victims of human trafficking.Viewers will also meet Mieczysław Sobczak, known as Dziki Mietek, who lives in Peru and is a renowned local shaman and herbalist.The creators of the documentary will also present a hockey coach living in Canada - Jarosław Byrski.Jego wychowankami są m.in.such stars as: Brent Burns, Bryan Bickell, and Rick Nash.
